cohort: 153 newborns hospitalized in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
finding: The prevalence of SNHL in newborns hospitalized in a NICU was 7.8%, with increased risk observed in preterm infants <28 weeks, those with neurological disorders, and those exposed to various perinatal risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of SNHL (p<0.0001).
